# BCGov Crow - v0.20.0

## Release type

Minor release: adds a focused high-availability design agent and supporting
maintenance-continuity skill without replacing existing implementation owners.

## Summary

Helps teams assess and design business-hours application releases and updates
against explicit critical-operation criteria. Separates approved design from
operational demonstration rather than promising zero downtime.

## Highlights

- Supports .NET, Java and PHP with conditional host/process, orchestrated
  container and managed-platform guidance.
- Examines reduced capacity, shared state, health, traffic and worker draining,
  long connections, version compatibility, schema evolution and recovery limits.
- Produces an evidence-backed gap assessment, phased target design, maintenance
  runbooks and representative-traffic verification criteria.
- Offers approval-gated specialist handoffs while preserving existing data,
  pipeline, update, application-development and testing boundaries.
- Excludes deployment, traffic execution, DR, host/OS and database-engine
  patching; identifies unverified dependencies instead of claiming coverage.

## Changes

- Added the High Availability Design Agent and modular supporting skill,
  report/handoff templates and deterministic contract checks.
- Added conditional consumer guards and discovery routes.
- Updated full-package manifests and retained compatibility wrappers together.

## Validation

- Candidate lint, focused tests, cross-platform asset checks, package inspection
  and independent reviews are required before publication.
- Contract validation checks recorded criteria and evidence relationships,
  not actual application continuity or production readiness.
- These notes do not attest to deployment, operational rehearsal or release
  execution. Exact-release Sonar and packaging gates remain required.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.20.0 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.20.0.zip --global --target copilot
```
